result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position by giving Customer a 30-day convenience-termination right, requiring a pro-rata refund of prepaid post-termination Fees, imposing no early-termination charge, and granting Vendor no corresponding right. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” creates a partial scope-reduction right beyond what the playbook requires and could affect unrelated committed-scope economics. The clause is otherwise professionally drafted.
